The evidence of the impact of AI chatbots on loneliness is still really unclear & depends on the chatbot approach.

This new study finds AI conversations increase loneliness, but previous published experiments find significant reduction or ambiguous results depending on usage. https://t.co/rwAlzo3Ye1

The new study found a small positive impact on loneliness, but it is hard to interpret whether this is actually due to chatbot use or the reflection intervention given the study design.
